title: Desk System Reference: Booking a Coverage Year's Benefit Allowance
content:
On coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans that grants its benefit allowance afresh each year, the allowance for the coverage year in progress is booked to the plan as one entry. Booking it moves benefit into the plan's allowance and nothing else on the coverage moves: no claim is answered and no premium changes. Afterwards the customer can see the year's benefit standing in the coverage history as an allowance reinstated.

## How the action is taken

The desk unlocks the tool `reinstate_benefit_allowance_e0b143ff` and calls it. One call books one allowance entry against the coverage for the coverage year now running, carrying the benefit granted as a movement into the plan's benefit allowance and accounted to the period the grant is taken in.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `protection_plan_id` | the reference number of the coverage record the allowance is granted on, as returned by the protection coverage lookup | an id |
| `allowance_amount` | the benefit granted for the coverage year | a positive amount in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the last step only |

## What comes back

A single confirmation line naming the reference number minted for the allowance entry, the coverage it was booked to, the amount granted in USD and the period it is accounted to. The line being returned at all is what indicates the entry was written; afterwards the grant appears in the coverage history.
